title: Does your “Mall World” contain Corny Haunted Houses/Muesems?
content: Every time I visit my mall world, there’s usually a long concrete hallway right off the movie theatre side. In it is a few rooms, one containing an entrance to a haunted house. The ones that pop up around October, or the ones you find at tourist attractions. The really corny ones. If this haunted house isn’t there, it’s usually a multi- room Meusem with cool wide open exhibits (that usually turns into a haunted house at some point) The Mall itself isn’t the only place these pop up. I’ve seen them on the city strip I always visit, and the giant theme park I always visit. Usually inside are wide open liminal spaces with some freaky scare actors chasing me around. Despite the feeling of dread I feel in these dreams, I’m always excited when I come across these haunted houses/museums, and can’t wait to get inside. Just wondering if this is common for your malls!
